summary: Idaho County ground cab, an L-4 built in 1940 in the Bitterroot National Forest and destroyed in 1955; no source describes what remains.

facts.design: L-4 cab on the ground, not on a tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955; no source describes what remains at the site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in and abandoned; no source describes a trail or current access.

evidence.quote: Nick Wynn Mountain Idaho 45.77278 -114.75932 Ground Gone

evidence.supports: six miles NNW of Magruder Ranger Station, Idaho County

sources.title: Nick Wynn Mtn. Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Two enthusiast lookout sites (firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts) agree on the 1940 L-4 cab and 1955 destruction; the FFLA list agrees on gone and ground. No Forest Service, register or newspaper source found, and no staffing or fire history found. Record has no built event; 1940 added here from both pages. Record county 'Idaho' is the county name, Idaho County, so no correction. Abandonment date unknown.
